module_name: Indonesian NLP Localization: IndoBERT, NusaBERT, InSet, Local Datasets
module_description: Module 10 is the localization module. Since the course serves Indonesian students and corpora, it teaches the local model and data landscape: IndoBERT/IndoRoBERTa and the Nusa language-model family (NusaBERT, NusaX), the InSet sentiment lexicon, Indonesian specific tasks (sentiment, emotion, abusive language, hoax, hate speech) and their datasets, and the practical problems of colloquial spelling, code-mixing and regional languages. Evaluation includes IndoNLU-style benchmarks and cross-temporal robustness.
core_concepts: Informal spelling, slang, code-mixing, regional languages
learning_outcomes: C3 Select the appropriate Indonesian model for a social-media task
C4 Build a labelled Indonesian dataset for a specific task
C5 Report IndoNLU-style metrics and analyze errors on local data
methods_models: Fine-tuning Indonesian checkpoints, label-set design, annotation protocol with agreement (Cohen's kappa), cross-validation
evaluation_metrics: Macro-F1 (IndoNLU convention), Cohen's kappa between annotators and model, confusion analysis per class
pitfalls_limitations: Dataset leakage, near-duplicate items across folds, class imbalance, over-reliance on one region's language, benchmark overfitting
tools_stack: transformers, IndoNLU tooling, InSet, datasets (SmSA, cASA emotion, Indonesian hoax datasets), snscrape-collected local corpora
commercial_platforms: Optional: commercial NLP APIs with Indonesian support for accuracy comparison
tools_access_cost: Free models (Hugging Face); commercial API calls priced per token
lab_activities: Build or reuse a labelled Indonesian set, fine-tune, and run error analysis on 50 misclassified samples
datasets_apis: Indonesian corpora: SmSA (sentiment), emotion corpus, hoax/fact-check sets, collected X posts on a local issue
assessment_methods: Lab notebook submission plus a 1-page interpretation with error analysis; graded on correctness, interpretation and documentation
data_collection_workflow: Collect posts -> clean text -> build annotation/codebook (human + LLM) -> validate with kappa -> train/evaluate -> archive labelled data and prompts
textbooks: InSet lexicon paper (2018) and Indonesian NLP survey papers
key_papers: Cross-temporal generalization of IndoBERT for Indonesian hoax news classification (2025)
2024-2026 papers comparing IndoBERT, IndoRoBERTa and NusaBERT on Indonesian social media tasks
trends_2024_2026: 2024-2026: Indonesian LLMs and NusaBERT for regional languages entered mainstream use; zero-shot LLM annotation of Indonesian social text is now common but still under-validated
industry_relevance: Core competency for social-listening analyst, insights researcher and content-strategy roles; employers (Pulsar, Talkwalker, Meltwater, Brandwatch) list sentiment/topic extraction as the default screening task for junior analysts.
localization_context: Indonesia-specific models and lexicons (IndoBERT family, NusaBERT, InSet) plus local datasets (Indonesian sentiment/emotion/hoax sets) are used as the primary lab material, because English-oriented models underperform on code-mixed colloquial Indonesian.
ethics_regulation: Annotation labor and consent, model reporting of error rates, and disclosure that automated affective labels on individuals can misrepresent them; UU PDP applies when the corpus contains identifiable user text.
case_study_scenarios: Analyze public sentiment on a local policy issue (e.g. tuition increase, layoffs) using an Indonesian model and report error types.
deliverable_format: Labelled dataset + fine-tuned model card + error analysis
